note: City of Hazen campground on Hazen Bay of Lake Sakakawea, 15 miles north of Hazen, on Corps of Engineers land: paved loops on open prairie above the bay, with cabins, three boat ramps, courtesy docks, a fish-cleaning station, playgrounds and a convenience store with bait, gas and a restaurant. About 48 of the sites go to seasonal campers by lottery; the rest are let by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator booking page (WebReserv) confirms $22 electric / $26 W&E / $30 FHU, 135 sites, showers, season late May-late Sept, 30-of-60-day limit, recreation-only. Seasonal share measured: 48 lottery sites (2026 results PDF) vs 61 nightly RV sites listed online (~56% nightly) - not mostly seasonal, keep. Google 4.5/59 (local, no gate). Lakeview stands; pin ~200 m, no move.
flags: LONG-STAY: Hazen Parks runs a seasonal lottery (2026 results list 48 site numbers, 105-305 range); WebReserv lists 61 numbered RV sites plus 3 electric sites for nightly booking. Nightly share ~56% of the hookup sites; terms say 'No residential occupancy is permitted ... not to facilitate employment'. Not a drop; note now says about 48 sites are seasonal.

HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived from the sweep note) is not stated on the operator page; WebReserv says four full-hookup sites have '30 amp plug ins' and names no 50-amp sites. Left as stored; the reviewer may want electric cleared or set to 30 if no 50-amp source turns up.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. The east loop's pads sit west of its own loop road (~47.5040,-101.6228); the bay shore is ~60 m east of the road through brush (loop road blocks). North-loop cabins stand ~30 m from the shore (~47.5055,-101.6235) but those are cabins; camper pads there are 100 m+ back. WebReserv site 314 pull-through 'has a great view of Lake Sakakawea' - a view, no site within 50 m identified.
PIN: stored 47.50191,-101.62303 is at the campground's entrance junction; the loops centre ~47.5035,-101.6240 (~200 m). No move.
